description: Promote a built extension to a release channel (stable, preview, beta, …) on extension.dev, headless. This WRITES: it is the only verb that changes what a channel points at. It is auth-gated by your stored login (extension_auth) or a release token in EXTENSION_DEV_TOKEN, minted and revoked under project settings, Access tokens. Tokens live at most 7 days, so CI must re-mint before expiry. The project comes from the token. Call extension_release_status to find a valid buildId. Cutting a version-bump PR is not available headlessly, because it writes to your source repo and needs an interactive login.

api.description: Platform base URL (default EXTENSION_DEV_API_URL, else https://www.extension.dev)

approvalId.description: The approval handle returned by a prior approval-required response. Promoting changes what a public channel serves and is not reversible in place, so when the platform's approval gate is on this needs a human approval: call once without this to get an approval id and URL, have a human approve at extension.dev, then call again with the same id.

browsers.description: Browsers to release (optional; auto-detected from the build)

buildId.description: Build commit SHA to promote (a 7-char short SHA is fine)

channel.description: Target release channel, e.g. stable, preview, beta

sourceChannel.description: Channel to promote from (optional; inferred otherwise)

name: extension_release_promote
